subject: Calyptus private deployment — architecture deep dive scheduling
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gordon <alex.gordon@calyptus.health>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Calyptus private deployment — architecture deep dive scheduling

Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery: Calyptus plans to run sensitive PHI workloads and prefers a private deployment (VPC-backed) with customer-managed keys, strict egress controls, and a requirement for per-request audit logs. Thanks for sharing the high-level constraints — that helps scope the next call.

Next step: schedule a 60–75 minute architecture deep dive with your infra/security leads so we can walk through:
- proposed VPC/topology options (peering vs. private link)
- KMS/HSM integration and key rotation model
- data residency and egress controls
- auth / SSO and service identity patterns
- monitoring, logging, and audit log delivery
- rollout/rollback and maintenance windows

I've proposed three slots below (all PT) — please confirm which works best and who from your side will join:
- Mon Aug 2, 10:00–11:15
- Tue Aug 3, 08:30–09:45
- Wed Aug 4, 13:00–14:15

I copied Sergio (our Solutions Architect) to cover VPC design and Vivek (account leader) for commercial/SLAs.

Attached: private_deploy_checklist.pdf — short checklist we use to prepare the deep dive. If you can share your SOC2/security questionnaire ahead of time, that will let us prioritize items.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

From: Alex Gordon <alex.gordon@calyptus.health>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@calyptus.health>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@calyptus.health>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Calyptus private deployment — architecture deep dive scheduling

Thanks Jasmine — good summary. Sanjay (our Director of Infrastructure) and Maya (Security Architect) will join the dive. Our preference is the morning of Aug 2 if possible.

Two requests before the call:
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS (we use AWS KMS with external key policy) and whether envelope encryption is supported in the Private deployment?
2) I'm attaching our SOC2 questionnaire (calyptus_soc2_questions.pdf). If you can flag any items that typically require design-level decisions, that will help us prioritize.

Proposed slot: Mon Aug 2, 10:00–11:15 PT — holds for now. If that fits your team's schedule, please send a calendar invite.

On a separate note: we may need a short network diagram outlining supported connectivity options (VPC peering, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink) for our procurement packet. If Sergio can bring a few sample topologies, that would be ideal.

Best,
Alex
Head of Platform Operations | Calyptus Health
alex.gordon@calyptus.health | +1 (650) 555-0133

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gordon <alex.gordon@calyptus.health>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Calyptus private deployment — architecture deep dive scheduling

Alex — perfect, thanks. Mon Aug 2, 10:00–11:15 PT is confirmed on our side.

Calendar invite sent (you should see it from redwood-calendar@redwood.com). Agenda attached: arch-deep-dive-agenda.pdf — includes timeblocks for network topology, KMS patterns, and an action-item capture at the end.

Two quick notes:
- Yes, Redwood Private supports customer-managed AWS KMS keys and envelope encryption patterns; Sergio will walk through the recommended key policy and cross-account access model.
- We'll aim to post a short one-page network options diagram before the call; Sergio will bring detailed patterns during the meeting.

If anything changes on your side, reply here and we'll adjust. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gordon <alex.gordon@calyptus.health>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@calyptus.health>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Calyptus private deployment — architecture deep dive scheduling

Hi Alex / Sanjay —

I'll be leading the architecture segment on Aug 2. I'll bring:
- a one-page comparison of VPC connectivity options we commonly deploy (peering, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink)
- recommended KMS/HSM integration patterns and example IAM/key policies
- a deployment topology that supports per-tenant isolation and audit-log delivery to your S3 destination

Attaching: redwood_vpc_patterns.pdf — quick reference we'll use as a starting point. If you can confirm whether you're using TGW today or prefer a peering-first approach, I can tailor the diagrams.

See you on Monday.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0147
